description: For \((i,j)\in\mathbb N^2\), put \(m=\max(i,j)\), and define \(r(i,j)=m^2+i\) if \(i<m\), and \(r(i,j)=m^2+m+j\) otherwise. This map is a bijection \(\mathbb N^2\to\mathbb N\). It preserves and reflects the order that compares \((\max(i,j),i,j)\) lexicographically.
